column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels in neutral Polish,
# using the terms Polish users of creative and system software know. The user is addressed
# informally ("twoje", "cię"), as in Polish system interfaces.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# name "Craft App Suite", app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft,
# PdfCraft, EffectCraft, WordCraft, DeckCraft, GridCraft, CADCraft, SoundCraft, FigCraft), "GitHub",
# Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Esc).
